headline: Drug-Resistant Infections Linked to $3.5 Trillion in Global Economic Losses
summary: Drug-resistant infections were linked to an estimated $3.5 trillion in global economic losses in 2021, according to recent research findings.
why: Antimicrobial resistance poses significant long-term structural risks to healthcare systems, labor productivity, and global economic growth.

impacts.name: Pharmaceuticals and Healthcare
impacts.why: Widespread antimicrobial resistance creates pressing demands for novel antibiotic development and expanded healthcare spending.
